about.intro: Bones & Beasts is a memory/dice hybrid game — roll to find your beast, then hunt for it across the tablet before the skulls (or someone else's beast) catch you.
about.howToPlayBody: Solo mode is just you against the tablet: roll for a fixed target animal, then flip tiles to collect all of its copies before another animal's set gets fully revealed first. Group mode matches 2-4 players online, racing to complete their own sets — with bonus gems and idols along the way that instantly reveal extra copies for whoever finds them.
about.builtWithBody: Expo, React Native, and TypeScript on the client; Colyseus powers real-time online Group play.
about.noteBody: This is an independent, actively-developed project — expect new features and rule tweaks over time. Thanks for playing!

privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what information Bones & Beasts collects and how it's used. There's no advertising and no analytics or tracking beyond what's described below.
privacyPolicy.accountBody: Creating an account (email/password, Google, or Sign in with Apple) is required to play. We use Firebase Authentication to manage sign-in, which stores your email address and display name (and, for Google/Apple, whatever basic profile info that provider shares with us — typically just your name and email). We don't see or store your password itself for email/password accounts; Firebase handles that directly. You can delete your account at any time from the Profile page.
privacyPolicy.soloBody: Solo games run entirely on your device. Your game history in the Stats tab (games played, wins, sets completed, times) is stored locally on-device and is never transmitted to us or anyone else, regardless of being signed in.
privacyPolicy.groupBody: When you join a Group game, your display name and your in-game actions (dice rolls, card flips) are sent to our game server so it can keep the shared board in sync for everyone in that game. This data exists only for the life of that game session — it's not saved afterward, sold, or shared with third parties.
privacyPolicy.childrenBody: Bones & Beasts is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from them.
privacyPolicy.changesBody: If how the app handles data changes — for example, if crash reporting, push notifications, or a paid subscription are added — this page will be updated to describe it.
privacyPolicy.questionsBody: If you have questions about this policy, please reach out through wherever you downloaded this app.

termsOfService.intro: By using Bones & Beasts, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the app.
termsOfService.gameBody: Bones & Beasts (see the About page for what it is and how it plays) is offered for entertainment purposes only.
termsOfService.fairPlayBody: In Group games, please play fairly — no exploiting bugs, automating your turns, or disrupting other players' games. We reserve the right to remove players from a game or lobby for disruptive behavior.
termsOfService.subscriptionsBody: Bones & Beasts Pro is offered as Monthly and Yearly auto-renewing subscriptions, and as a one-time Lifetime purchase, unlocking online Group play beyond the free trial period. Monthly and Yearly subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account (iOS) or Google Play account (Android) at confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your device's account settings — this doesn't affect access to Solo play, which is always free. The Lifetime purchase is a one-time payment and does not renew.
termsOfService.noWarrantyBody: The app is provided "as is," without warranties of any kind. We don't guarantee it will be uninterrupted, error-free, or available at all times — especially the online Group mode, which depends on a game server that may be updated, restarted, or taken offline without notice.
termsOfService.liabilityBody: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we aren't liable for any damages arising from your use of, or inability to use, the app.
termsOfService.changesBody: These terms may be updated as the app changes. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the revised terms.
